newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton demand remains brisk.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton demand remains brisk.

text.p: Many European traders indicated that demand for raw cotton in Europe remains brisk, despite the strength of the dollar.
The dollar's strength against local currencies was cited as one reason for more optimism, since the effect of a stronger dollar was to reduce competition for yarn and textiles from the Far East.
Raw cotton sales activity has continued to be mainly focused on the popular central Asian better qualities.
